name: Takenaka Natsuhi
source:
The captain of the boys' basketball team at Keishin Academy. He's very competitive and sometimes acts hostile to the girls' basketball club, but he starts to secretly support them after he learns about their passion for playing.
He's the childhood friend of [url=/c32367]Misawa Maho[/url] and [url=/c32366]Nagatsuka Saki[/url], and he's got a sweet spot for [url=/c32365]Hakamada Hinata[/url].
